title: Predicting Factors for Asthma Remission in Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the predicting factors for asthma remission in children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children who were diagnosed as having asthma during the period of 2004-2007.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who had underlying disease with chronic respiratory disease (ex. tuberculosis, bronchiectasis), primary immunodeficiency, other seriously interfering diseases
* Medical records have been lost.
study_population: The children who were diagnosed as having asthma at pediatric allergy clinic were recruited.
